_doc: Ikonerna för mallarna i lådorna till vänster (Väderkvarnen och Häxkitteln). Ett ark per område ritas av gpt-image-2 via OpenRouter i ett fast rutnät och skärs ut av tools/icons/make_icons.py till assets/icons/<område>/<id>.png (128 px). Rutorna läses rad för rad; null är en tom ruta. Kör: python3 -I tools/icons/make_icons.py '{"sheet": "water"}'.
style: A sheet of small game UI icons for a stylized fantasy game editor, laid out as an exact grid of {cols} columns and {rows} rows of equal square cells with even gaps. Each cell holds one icon: a rounded-square tile with a soft dark {tint} gradient background, and on it one bold, instantly readable symbol of the subject, centered, filling about 70 percent of the tile. Simple chunky shapes, thick clean silhouettes, stylized painted look with soft gradients and gentle highlights, like World of Warcraft or Overwatch ability icons but simpler and clearer at a tiny size. High contrast, few details, consistent style and lighting across all icons. Plain flat {page} page background between the tiles. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no borders other than the tile itself.
